# Vendor / third-party references

## pyVoIP (phone calls)

MedNote uses [pyVoIP](https://github.com/tayler6000/pyVoIP) for optional server-side SIP calling.

Install via pip (see `backend/requirements.txt`):

```bash
pip install pyVoIP
# or from source:
pip install git+https://github.com/tayler6000/pyVoIP.git
```

Configure SIP in the backend environment — see `backend/README.md`.
